title: Calibrating Agent-Based Models Using Uncertainty Quantification Methods
rationale: 摘要提出HistoryMatching+ABC校准流程，并称用三种复杂度模型展示；尚未核参照、误差定义或比较预算。

title: Generation of Synthetic Populations in Social Simulations: A Review of Methods and Practices
rationale: 摘要回顾合成人口构建方法及JASSS2011–2021实践；本轮只纳入2022综述，不新增其早期被引样本。

title: Unpacking a Black Box: A Conceptual Anatomy Framework for Agent-Based Social Simulation Models
rationale: 摘要提出agency/structure/environment/actions-interactions/temporality五构件与透明性分类；规范价值与效果需全文分开。

title: Using Machine Learning for Agent Specifications in Agent-Based Models and Simulations: A Critical Review and Guidelines
rationale: 摘要结构综述ML用于主体结构/决策规格并按模型用途给指南；不能当LLM特定验证结果。

title: Social Simulation Models as Refuting Machines
rationale: 摘要主张模拟反例可反驳理论信念；理论排除与现实机制识别需全文核查。

title: Inverse Generative Social Science: Backward to the Future
rationale: 摘要iGSS从宏观目标反向演化微观规则家族；限制在预设原语/组合，不预认唯一真实机制。

title: Reliable and Efficient Agent-Based Modeling and Simulation
rationale: 摘要krABMaga展示Rust框架、性能/扩展与校准例；安全性/速度作者主张不当独立效度。

title: Visual ODD: A Standardised Visualisation Illustrating the Narrative of Agent-Based Models
rationale: 摘要vODD提出固定位置的图示、模板与实例；描述可读性/比较收益待全文，不当强制报告标准。

title: Communicating Agent-Based Models to Stakeholders: A Scoping Review
rationale: 摘要称65篇scopingreview并指出交流评价缺口；尚未核筛选流程、样本年份或利益相关者效果。

title: AGENTBLOCKS: A Community Platform for Sharing, Comparing, and Improving Reusable Building Blocks for (Agent-Based) Models
rationale: 摘要AGENTBLOCKS提出可重用机制代码组件/文档模板与社区平台；公开平台不当已验证标准或采用效果。
